The '''2024 Retro League Event 5''' was the fifth event of the [[2024 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]], won by [[Jonny Chu]].<ref name="t84007" /> It ran 9 October – 23 November 2024 in [[Premiere - Reflections II (Modified)]] format.<ref name="t84007" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II (Modified)]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 9 October – 23 November 2024
* '''Players:''' 68 (in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
